# Wellguard source snapshot

This directory is a pinned source snapshot of the private
`Velgard-SK/vanguard` repository at revision
`d9e2b785b973bd5a44af8ec86766808542ae8cb6`, copied with the repository owner's
authorization for reproducible, credential-free production builds.

Wellguard does not modify Vanguard's collection or projection internals. The
integration boundary is `agent/tools/vanguard.ts`; its generated engagement and
reviewed profile live under `integrations/vanguard/`.
